The video shows an Ungulate Cladogram with two main branches: Perissodactyls (odd-toed ungulates) leading to Horses, and Artiodactyls (even-toed ungulates) branching into Whippomorphs and Ruminants. Whippomorphs further split into Hippos and Cetacea, while Ruminants include Pecorans and Mouse Deer.

The video shows a detailed cladogram of ungulates, highlighting the classification of Perissodactyls (odd-toed ungulates) and Artiodactyls (even-toed ungulates). The Perissodactyls branch into Horses, Hippos, and Cetacea, while the Artiodactyls split into Whippomorphs (Ruminants), Pecorans, and Mouse Deer.
